user.title: Log in to Overcast
user.description: Choose how to log in to Overcast.

menu_options.qr: QR code (approve in the Overcast app)

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Overcast again
reauth_confirm.description: Overcast no longer accepts the saved login. Choose how to log in again.

menu_options.qr: QR code (approve in the Overcast app)

email.title: Overcast email login
email.description: Enter the email and password of your Overcast account. The password is only sent to overcast.fm and is not stored.

data_description.email: The email address of your Overcast account.

progress.qr_scan:
Scan this code with the camera on the iPhone or iPad that runs Overcast, then approve the login in the app.

![QR code]({qr_image})

If the code does not show, open this link on that device instead:

`{qr_link}`

This step finishes on its own once Overcast approves the login. The code expires after 5 minutes.

error.invalid_auth: Overcast rejected the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach overcast.fm. Check the connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Overcast account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That login is for a different Overcast account than this entry.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach overcast.fm. Check the connection and try again.
abort.qr_timeout: The QR code was not approved within 5 minutes. Start again to get a new code.

data.mark_played: Mark played when an episode ends

data_description.mark_played: For episodes started from the media browser: mark them played in Overcast when they play to within a minute of the end.

play_latest.name: Play latest
play_latest.description: Play the newest unplayed episode of each named podcast on a media player. The first plays now; the rest play in order as each one finishes.

podcasts.name: Podcasts
podcasts.description: Podcast names. An exact title match wins; otherwise the first title that contains the text.

mark_played.name: Mark played
mark_played.description: Mark each episode played in Overcast when it plays to within a minute of the end. Stopping it early never marks it played.

resume_position.name: Resume position
resume_position.description: Start from the position saved in Overcast.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Speed to record in Overcast, from 0.75 to 2.25. It does not change how fast the player plays. Leave empty to keep the podcast's Overcast setting.

config_entry_id.name: Overcast account
config_entry_id.description: Which Overcast account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

mark_played.name: Mark played
mark_played.description: Mark an episode played in Overcast without playing it.

episode_url.name: Episode URL
episode_url.description: Overcast episode link, such as https://overcast.fm/+d5BN-RlCs.

config_entry_id.name: Overcast account
config_entry_id.description: Which Overcast account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Reload subscriptions and clear cached episode lists.

config_entry_id.name: Overcast account
config_entry_id.description: Account to refresh. Leave empty to refresh all.
